from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_key_includes_all_inputs():
    k1 = make_key("job", 1, 1)
    k2 = make_key("job", 2, 1)
    k3 = make_key("job", 1, 2)
    k4 = make_key("job", 1, 1)
    assert k1 != k2
    assert k1 != k3
    assert k1 == k4

def test_key_distinguishes_text():
    k1 = make_key("job", 1, 1)
    k2 = make_key("job2", 1, 1)
    assert k1 != k2

def test_score_recomputes_on_input_change():
    store = {}
    calls = {"n": 0}
    def compute():
        calls["n"] += 1
        return calls["n"]
    s1 = score(store, "job", 1, 1, compute)
    assert s1 == 1
    s2 = score(store, "job", 1, 1, compute)
    assert s2 == 1
    s3 = score(store, "job", 2, 1, compute)
    assert s3 == 2
    s4 = score(store, "job", 1, 2, compute)
    assert s4 == 3
    s5 = score(store, "job2", 1, 1, compute)
    assert s5 == 4

def test_score_none_inputs():
    store = {}
    calls = {"n": 0}
    def compute():
        calls["n"] += 1
        return calls["n"]
    s1 = score(store, None, None, None, compute)
    assert s1 == 1
    s2 = score(store, None, None, None, compute)
    assert s2 == 1

def test_key_no_ambiguous_concatenation():
    k1 = make_key("ab", 1, 1)
    k2 = make_key("a", 2, 1)
    assert k1 != k2

def test_key_distinguishes_versions():
    k1 = make_key("job", 1, 1)
    k2 = make_key("job", 1, 2)
    k3 = make_key("job", 2, 1)
    assert k1 != k2
    assert k1 != k3

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_key_includes_all_inputs()
    test_key_distinguishes_text()
    test_score_recomputes_on_input_change()
    test_score_none_inputs()
    test_key_no_ambiguous_concatenation()
    test_key_distinguishes_versions()
    print("all tests passed")

def make_key(text, profile, criteria):
    return (text, profile, criteria)
